hero.title: Our Team & Volunteers
hero.description: Meet the field leaders, educators, doctors, and volunteers driving grassroots change.

teamSection.title: Meet our core team & volunteers
teamSection.description: Working side-by-side with village communities across education, nutrition, and healthcare.

members.name: Meera Krishnan
members.bio: Leads 54 community-run education and nutrition hubs across 42 partner villages.
members.quote: Lasting change begins when we listen to village leaders first.

members.name: Dr. Sana Qureshi
members.imageAlt: Dr. Sana Qureshi, Chief Medical Officer
members.bio: Heads our mobile clinics and trains village women as frontline health guides.
members.quote: Trusted care at a family's doorstep bridges the widest gap in rural health.

members.name: Savita Devi
members.imageAlt: Savita Devi, Head Coordinator of Community Kitchens
members.bio: Coordinates 18 local mothers preparing fresh midday meals for 300+ families daily.
members.quote: Every plate carries the warmth and pride of our shared neighborhood table.

members.name: Aarav Mehta
members.bio: Designs hands-on science kits, solar classrooms, and rural teaching fellowships.
members.quote: Right learning tools light up a child's confidence for life.

members.name: Anil Sharma
members.bio: Weekend architect volunteer building open-air libraries and leading village drives.
members.quote: Showing up week after week turns small ideas into thriving hubs.

members.name: Neha Kapoor
members.bio: Trains rural college fellows to lead daily reading and wellness circles.
members.quote: Local youth mentors are the strongest role models a village can have.
